4 Google listing checks before the holiday rush.

1. Pick your Book buttons. Google now lets business owners choose which appointment and reservation links show on the listing.
2. Set holiday hours for every day you close early or open late.
3. Search your business the way a customer would and make sure your stars show.
4. Add one fresh photo of your shop, your team or your work.

Ten minutes, and your listing is ready for December.

Send this to whoever manages your Google listing.

Your YouTube Shorts can have a real thumbnail now.

As of Nov 23, YouTube lets every creator upload a custom thumbnail for Shorts, on desktop or mobile, and change it after publishing.

Before: YouTube picks a random frame, often mid-blink, with no words.
After: your face, three big words on the topic, and the same look every time so people know it is you.

Send this to whoever posts your videos.

body.summary:
Your YouTube Shorts can have a real thumbnail now.

YouTube opened custom Shorts thumbnails to all creators on Nov 23, on desktop and mobile, at upload or after publishing. Until now most business Shorts showed whatever frame YouTube picked.

A simple standard for a business channel:
1. Your face, looking at the camera
2. Three big words that name the topic
3. The same colors and layout every time

Then go back and update your last five Shorts.

Send this to whoever posts your videos.
